# Dyrected

Canonical documentation map generated by @dyrected/knowledge.

## Documentation

- [Database Adapters](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/adapters/databases): Choose, configure, migrate, and extend Dyrected database adapters.
- [Storage Adapters](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/adapters/storage): Configure file storage, public URLs, uploads, and image processing.
- [Admin UI Configuration](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/admin/configuration): Complete reference for all admin.* options on collections, globals, and fields that control the Dyrected Admin dashboard.
- [CSV Import & Export](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/admin/csv-import): Bulk-import records from a spreadsheet and export any collection to CSV directly from the Admin UI.
- [Admin UI](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/admin/overview): How the Dyrected admin works, where it can live, and what changes when you embed it.
- [Spreadsheet View](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/admin/spreadsheet-editor): Edit multiple records at once from the collection list — inline in the cell, or via an anchored popover — without opening individual edit forms.
- [View Preferences](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/admin/view-preferences): How editors personalise column order and field layout in the Admin UI, and how admins publish team-wide defaults.
- [Billing & Plans](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/cloud/billing): Plan limits, quotas, and what happens when you hit them.
- [Workspace Management](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/cloud/workspaces): Managing teams and collaborative environments in Dyrected Cloud.
- [Access Control](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/concepts/access-control): Collection and field-level access control using JavaScript functions or Jexl expression strings.
- [Authentication Model](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/concepts/auth-model): How `auth: true` turns a collection into an authentication provider — endpoints, tokens, injected fields, and the stateless JWT model.
- [Collections & Globals](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/concepts/collections-and-globals): The two building blocks of a Dyrected content model — when to use each and what they give you.
- [Understanding Depth](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/concepts/depth): Learn how the depth parameter controls relationship hydration in your queries.
- [Dynamic Options](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/concepts/dynamic-options): Populate select, multiSelect, and radio fields from a database, an external API, or reactive sibling field values.
- [Fields](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/concepts/fields): How fields define the shape of your content — the types available, the properties they share, and how structural fields compose complex documents.
- [Hooks](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/concepts/hooks): Run custom logic at every stage of the document lifecycle — on the server and in the Admin UI.
- [Lifecycle Events](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/concepts/lifecycle-events): Respond to publishing transitions, updates, and events using hooks and durable outbox notifications.
- [Relationships](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/concepts/relationships): How collections reference each other, how related documents are hydrated, and the difference between relationship and join fields.
- [Schema Definition](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/concepts/schema): How Dyrected stores data, how your config maps to database columns, and how schema changes are managed without breaking migrations.
- [Workflows](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/concepts/workflows): Learn how to configure states, capability gates, and custom editorial approval flows.
- [Dyrected Cloud Backend](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/deployment/cloud): Use Dyrected Cloud for the backend, then choose hosted admin or embedded admin based on the handoff you want.
- [Docker Deployment](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/deployment/docker): Self-hosting Dyrected in a container.
- [Embedded Admin](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/deployment/embedding): Mount the Dyrected admin inside your app and understand when to choose it over the hosted admin.
- [Railway Deployment](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/deployment/railway): Deploy a self-hosted Dyrected app to Railway with a managed Postgres database.
- [Vercel Deployment](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/deployment/vercel): Deploying a Dyrected-powered Next.js app to Vercel.
- [Introduction](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/getting-started/introduction): What Dyrected is, who it is for, and how the hosting options fit together.
- [Production Checklist](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/getting-started/production-checklist): Best practices and checklist items for preparing your Dyrected app for production deployment.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/getting-started/quickstart): Get Dyrected running and choose your backend, admin location, and update model clearly.
- [Adding Authentication](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/adding-authentication): Add a users collection with login, JWT auth, and protected routes.
- [Admin SSO](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/admin-sso): Configure SSO for the Dyrected Admin UI using external OIDC providers such as Okta, Azure AD, or Google.
- [Using Dyrected with AI Coding Tools](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/ai-integration): How to set up AI coding agents to work correctly with Dyrected — a complete intent-to-pattern reference, schema rules, and critical DO NOTs.
- [Audit Trail](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/audit-trail): Track who changed what and when — automatic system metadata plus optional full activity logging.
- [Building a Blog](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/building-a-blog): Create a posts collection, fetch content in your frontend, and let clients edit through the Admin UI.
- [Building a Page Builder](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/building-a-page-builder): Use the blocks field to let editors assemble pages from reusable content blocks.
- [Configuring Storage](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/configuring-storage): Step-by-step setup for S3, Cloudflare R2, DigitalOcean Spaces, and Cloudinary.
- [Editorial Approval Workflow](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/editorial-approval-workflow): Guide on setting up a publishing chain with capability gates and comment requirements.
- [Using Core in Enterprise Environments](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/enterprise-core): A practical guide to running @dyrected/core in larger teams, regulated environments, and multi-tenant deployments.
- [File Uploads](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/file-uploads): Accept file uploads, store them locally or in S3/Cloudinary, and display images.
- [Globals & Site Settings](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/globals-and-site-settings): Use globals to manage singleton content like site settings, navigation, and footer links.
- [Handling Form Submissions](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/handling-form-submissions): Learn how to build contact forms, lead captures, and waitlists using Dyrected collections.
- [Invite-Only Registration](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/invite-only-registration): Restrict sign-up so new users can only join via invitation.
- [Live Preview](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/live-preview): Build a real landing page from blocks, then edit it visually — type and watch it update, or click any element to jump straight to its field.
- [Migrating to Workflows](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/migrating-to-workflows): Learn how to upgrade your existing string-based status fields to the new Editorial Approval Workflow.
- [Dynamic Pages in Nuxt](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/nuxt-dynamic-pages): Build a dynamic, block-based page builder in Nuxt 3 using catch-all routing and live previews.
- [Role-Based Access Control](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/role-based-access-control): Restrict what different users can read, create, edit, and delete based on their role.
- [Sending Email](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/sending-email): Configure transactional email, customise built-in templates, and send emails from hooks.
- [Separating Admin Auth](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/separating-admin-auth): Use __admins to isolate dashboard access from your application's user accounts.
- [Using Hooks](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/guides/using-hooks): Practical patterns for server-side and Admin UI hooks — from auto-slugs to cascading dropdowns.
- [Next.js Integration](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/integrations/nextjs): Complete guide to using Dyrected in a Next.js App Router project.
- [Nuxt 3 Integration](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/integrations/nuxt): Complete guide to using Dyrected in a Nuxt 3 application with SSR and composables.
- [React Integration](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/integrations/react): Use Dyrected in a Vite, CRA, or any non-Next.js React application.
- [SDK (Framework-Agnostic)](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/integrations/sdk): Using @dyrected/sdk in vanilla JS, SvelteKit, Astro, and any other environment.
- [Vue 3 Integration](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/integrations/vue): Use Dyrected in a standard Vue 3 application with composables, live preview, and the Admin UI bridge.
- [Generate a Slug from a Title](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/recipes/auto-slug): Keep server-written slugs correct while giving editors immediate feedback.
- [Show an Admin Field Only When Relevant](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/recipes/conditional-admin-field): Use a serializable condition without confusing presentation with security.
- [Validate Related Fields Before Saving](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/recipes/cross-field-validation): Merge partial updates and reject invalid cross-field combinations.
- [Update a Dropdown from Another Field](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/recipes/dependent-dropdown): Recalculate editor options instantly while keeping server writes valid.
- [Add Draft, Review, and Publishing States](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/recipes/editorial-publishing-workflow): Apply the standard workflow with capability-aware server enforcement.
- [Recipes](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/recipes): Compiled implementation patterns with authored decisions, cautions, and alternatives.
- [Limit Documents to Their Owner](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/recipes/owner-scoped-access): Enforce row-level access and assign ownership on the trusted server.
- [Build Flexible Pages from Reusable Blocks](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/recipes/page-builder-blocks): Model editor-controlled layouts with stable block contracts.
- [Model a Relationship and Its Reverse Lookup](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/recipes/relationship-and-reverse-join): Store one owning reference and expose a bounded virtual reverse lookup.
- [Restrict Content Operations by User Role](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/recipes/role-based-access): Express least-privilege operation rules in server configuration.
- [Rename a Field Without Orphaning Existing Data](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/recipes/safe-field-rename): Read the old key while migrating documents to the new field name.
- [Create a Media Upload Collection](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/recipes/upload-collection): Validate uploads and store accessible editorial metadata.
- [Configuration Reference](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/reference/configuration): Detailed reference for the Dyrected configuration object and content contract.
- [Field Types Reference](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/reference/fields): Field behavior, modeling guidance, examples, and generated public contracts.
- [Workflow Reference](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/reference/generated-workflows): Workflow states, capabilities, revisions, lifecycle events, and generated public contracts.
- [API Reference](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/reference/introduction): Overview of the Dyrected REST API and SDK.
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/reference/openapi): Generate and consume the project-specific Dyrected OpenAPI document.
- [REST API Reference](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/reference/rest-api): Endpoint behavior, authentication, filtering, errors, and a generated OpenAPI inventory.
- [SDK Reference](https://docs.dyrected.com/docs/reference/sdk): Use the framework-agnostic @dyrected/sdk client safely and typefully.
